content: Yɛsu anà saba
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkäl mulyaŋ uboo a an'ywaŋ a blɛ ilä a saba. Alɔŋki ande bàkäl anà ngyal, waa bàbwe imfà a blɛ ntɔn mudyà.
Mpal bàmɛn Amfarisi abun, ba bàtɛn a nde naa: « Ler, alɔŋki angye bàmukyer ndaa mpa bàfàkyer kilä a saba! »
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: « Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki ndaa kàkyer David mpal kàwem nde ngyal anà baar bàkäl anà nde?
Nde kàbilà u ndwà a Nzam, kàwɛl mampà bàfàpà ibɔɔn akà Nzam waa kàdi ma, mumwɛy nde kàpɛ baar bàkäl anà nde, itàkal naa ma angaŋ mpɛl bàfàdyà.
Itàkal naa nkye bɛ, bɛ làtäŋ anki uboo a Un'kɔɔn naa ilä a saba, u ndwà a Nzam, angaŋ bàfàbɛy saba, mukɔɔn akal unsà ube?
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa apà ye anà ndaa yàŋàsöön ndwà a Nzam!
Kya bɛ làlàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ mbuul a ndaa ayi: "Mɛ in'kwen ngyɛb wɛɛ kà ibɔɔn anki", bɛ baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ube làlatsüül anki mbar.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur wà nkum a saba. »
Mbuur anà kɔɔ aŋàkwɛkà
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde paa, nde kàkyen ndwà a nköŋ aba, waa kàbilà kwo.
Akun kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà kɔɔ aŋàkwɛkà. Amfarisi bàkwen mufüün Yɛsu: ba bun'fuul naa: « Nkye un'kɔɔn abi akyàpà mbwo mukɔɔr mbuur kilä a saba? »
Wɛɛ nde kafuur naa: « Nà uboo abɛ, isàkal naa nde we awà un'kɔk mwɛy anà wa ubü uboo a fu kilä a saba, waa nde mpa ukàsaab wa?
Wɛɛ mbuur kan'söön un'kɔk! Kyakin, mbwo yà mwo mukyer ubwaŋ kilä a saba. »
Apan nde kàtɛn a mbuur awun naa: « Sen kɔɔ angye. » Nde waa kàsen la, la sye waa làbwɛŋ asànaa lumwɛy.
Amfarisi bàtoo ba, ba bàkàsà nköŋ ntɔn mutsul mbar naa ba bàyun'dwa aben.
Un'syääl kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam
Mpal kàyöb Yɛsu ndaa ayin, nde kàlwomà kà ikal akin, baar mbɔɔn bàkyer un'lab, waa kàkɔɔr ba banswà,
wɛɛ nde katsüŋ a ngwal naa ba bàkɔɔn akyään naa nde wà nà.
Kàkyer nde abà ntɔn ndaa akwà kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay ikwe:

content.text: Nkwen Aŋàbwaŋ amɛ kàkwen mɛ musɔɔl, mɛ in'sàsà Dweelà amɛ udu a nde, waa nde usàkyään balàbal akà in'sɛŋ.
Mɛ in'sàsà Dweelà amɛ udu a nde,
nde asàkyään un'kɔɔn awà an'pà mɛ akà in'sɛŋ.
Nde usàtwal anki an'sye, nde usàsà anki in'kwɛŋ,
akà mbuur mwɛy usàwem anki ndaa ande kà an'balàbal.
Nde usàbɔɔl anki kite a iful aŋàbɔɔl,
nde usàdim anki mwinà akalɛɛmà unsinsi.
Nde asàkyer abà tii mpal làsàwal balàbal iböŋ.
Waa in'sɛŋ myàsàsà làkyän a mya kà ikɔb ande. »

content: Mfüün anà mfuur a Yɛsu
Apan ba bun'twääl ŋukɔŋ mwɛy wà ikwàmii anà wànkiin. Yɛsu laa kun'kɔɔr nde, waa kàsɛmà musà ndaa anà muman.
In'sɛŋ a baar myanswà myàkäl mubem anà mutɛn naa: « Nkye wà kà mwan a David anki? »
Mpal bàwem Amfarisi abwɛy, ba bàtɛn naa: « Mbuur wunà insɔŋà ayiböŋ u mbwo a Bɛlzàbul, mfum a insɔŋà. »
Yɛsu kàyöb an'kyän aba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Imwol kyanswà akyà ifàkaabà kya ŋakwo, ikyer afàpää. Bul làmwɛy, itàkal ywar làmwɛy làŋàkaabà la ŋakwo, la làfàtsim anki.
Isàkal naa Satanà kan'twey Satanà, nde wàŋakaabà anà nde ŋakwo: apan imwol ande isàtsim aben?
Isàkal naa mɛ, mɛ insɔŋà in'kaböŋà kà ikɔ̈b a Bɛlzàbul, baan abɛ insɔŋà bàfàböŋ kà ikɔ̈b a nà? Lalan ba ŋakwo bàsàkal atsüül a nsaŋ abɛ!
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mɛ insɔŋà in'fàböŋ a Dweelà a Nzam, ikaswaŋà naa Imwol a Nzam kyàkyàyà akà bɛ. »

« Itàkal sye naa nkye mbuur mwɛy kan'kwo ubilà u ndwà a ŋangwal anà ugyɔɔr indiir ande, isàkal naa nde mbuur a ngwal awà ŋàtun'bäm anki in'siŋ? Ungö akun'bäm in'siŋ, nde kan'kwo ugyɔɔr indiir byanswà u ndwà ande.
Mbuur mpa awà anà mɛ, nde kan'kwen anki, mbuur mpa akaböbà anà mɛ, nde wàmupay.
Undiir awun, mɛ alàkyään naa bàsàdwääl baar nkul a man'be manswà anà mbɛɛy yanswà, wɛɛ bàsàdwääl anki nkul a mbɛɛy a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl.
Mbuur asàtɛn ndaa a insoonà a Mwan a mbuur, nde bàsun'dwääl nkul. Wɛɛ mbuur asàtɛn ndaa a insoonà a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, bàsun'dwääl anki nkul u mɛɛn mà itàkal u mɛɛn amà isàyà. »
Un'te anà imbɛŋ a wa
« Isàkal naa un'te wà ubwaŋ, mbɛŋ awa ikal ubwaŋ, isàkal naa un'te wà un'be, mbɛŋ awa ikal yàmbe. Ntɔn un'te bàfàyöb u mbɛŋ awa.
Mbil a iyäy! Nkye baar abe asànaa bɛ, bɛ lan'kwo mutɛn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ? Ntɔn ayà ifàtoo u mun a mbuur, ifàfà u mpem ande.
Mbuur aŋàbwaŋ afàwal indiir aŋàbwaŋ unsà un'naaŋ ande wàŋàbwaŋ, wɛɛ mbuur un'be afàwal indiir ibe unsà un'naaŋ ande wube.
Waa mɛ, mɛ alàkyään naa: kà ilä a nsaŋ, baar bàsàsà in'lɔɔn a ndaa a bunàbun yanswà bàsatɛɛnà ba.
Ntɔn ntɛɛn angye ŋakwo isatsüül mbar. »
Ndɔ̈ɔ̈m a impà mwɛy
Apan alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy anà Amfarisi amwɛy bàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikwen naa ngye iswɛŋ impà mwɛy. »
Nde kafuur naa: « Nkööl a baar abe anà yà inswem yàmulɔm impà, wɛɛ ba impà asin bàman anki, impà nsil kyà ŋangɔɔm Yɔnas.
Undiir awun, asànaa Yɔnas kàkyer nde myäänà in'tär anà mpib tär uboo a dum a nsö a kölàköl, abun sye Mwan a mbuur asàkyer myäänà in'tär anà mpib tär ungyɛl a mɛɛn.
Ilä a nsaŋ, baar a Ninivɛ bàsàmbarà kusà a baar a nkööl ayi waa bàsafüün, ntɔn baar a Ninivɛ bàbuul mpem aba mpal bàwem ba an'lɔɔŋ a Yɔnas. Wɛɛ apà, we anà mbuur kan'söön Yɔnas!
Ilä a nsaŋ, mfum un'kaar a Ngyɛl asàmbarà kusà a baar a ŋàbà, ntɔn nde kàfü kwɛl muyàwem an'yeerà a Salɔmun. Waa apà, we anà mbuur kan'söön Salɔmun! »
Mfuurà a dweelà a làbe
« Uman naa dweelà a làbe lan'too uboo a mbuur, la làfàkyà nsye a ipɔl muleŋ ikal akàyöör, la làsàkɔɔn aman,
laa làtɛn la naa: "Mɛ in'kyer afurà ndwà amɛ kàtoo mɛ." Mpal làtol la, làman la ya yà ipɔl, yàŋàkɔɔm anà yàŋàlɔ̈ɔ̈n,

apan laa làkyà la mukàwal an'dweelà asin nsambwaar man'söön la unsà ube, laa màbilà ma, màbwaay ma. Mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbuur awà laa utay wa wàŋàsöönà mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàkäl nde awà kusà. Ya sye isàkal abà akà nkööl a mbe yi. »
Ngwän anà atɔŋ a Yɛsu
Mpal kàkäl Yɛsu muyäm a iköŋ a baar, le ngwän anà atɔŋ ande bàkäl u nsà, ba bàleŋà muyäm anà nde.
Mbuur mwɛy waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Le, ngwa anà atɔŋ angye bà u nsà anà bàmuleŋà muyäm anà ngye. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Maa nà, anà atɔŋ amɛ bànà? »
Apan, nde kàsilà kɔɔ udu a alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn naa: « Le maa anà atɔŋ amɛ.
Ntɔn mbuur wanswà afàlab ukwen a Taaràmɛ awà u du, nde wà un'tɔŋ amɛ wàbaal anà wun'kaar, nde wà maa. »
